_comment: magazine.json — shared style definition for the Magazine style.
Clean editorial layout: single wide column, generous margins,
sans-serif headings over serif body. Warm off-white palette with
md_harden reads 'hardening' when --style magazine is passed.
md2pdf engines read 'design' for reference; rendering is in the .typ/.css files.

design._comment: Rendering decisions — implemented in magazine.typ and style_magazine.css.

_comment: Conventions that md_harden enforces when --style magazine is passed.
Magazine style uses lowercase source: attribution (editorial house style).
Bold-heading promotion confidence is slightly lower — magazine prose
uses bold lead-ins more freely than IC reports.

pull_quote_attribution._comment: Magazine style uses lowercase source: — editorial convention.
pull_quote_attribution.action: Normalise 'Source:' -> 'source:'. Lowercase matches editorial house style.

pull_quote_missing_source._comment: Lower than default — magazine pull-quotes often intentionally lack attribution.

bold_headings._comment: Slightly lower confidence — magazine prose uses bold lead-ins more freely.
